name: VoiceLab - Voice AI Experimentation
readme:
**Storage:** 100GB ephemeral + 50GB persistent

## VoiceLab - Voice AI Experimentation

Docker-based platform for voice conversion and vocal isolation with RTX 4090/5090 GPUs.

### Features:
- Applio-RVC v3.5.1 for voice conversion
- audio-separator for vocal isolation
- PyTorch 2.5.1 + CUDA 12.4
- Web UI on port 6969

### Access:
Once the pod starts, access Applio Web UI at:
http://[pod-id]-6969.proxy.runpod.net

### Workspace:
- /workspace/data/raw - Upload audio files
- /workspace/data/isolated - Vocal isolation outputs
- /workspace/data/datasets - Training datasets
- /workspace/models - Trained RVC models
- /workspace/outputs - Experiment results

### Documentation:
https://github.com/HeapsGo0d/VoiceLab
